title: KRAS G12D Inhibitor (BI 4015092) – CRC Development Plan & China Integration

background.text: BI 4015092 is a late follower; several competitors at least two years ahead. Fierce competition in G12D KRAS inhibitors. HP BUEC endorsed accelerated plans for CRC development with assumptions/risks. SoD for KRAS G12D inh. (BU) CRC noted as 2025 milestone. eTPP targets: 2L+ CRC combo w/ cetuximab (AA, US); 1L CRC combo w/ cetuximab + FOLFOX (FA, US). Development plan includes: DE solid tumors, DE 2L+ CRC, backfill cohorts 2L+ CRC, RDO 2L+ CRC, pivotal Ph2 2L+ CRC (single arm n=90), DE 1L CRC, RDO 1L CRC, rPh3 1L CRC vs FOLFOX+/-Bev. Risk: if any competitor receives FA in 1L CRC and becomes SoC
background.quote:
Fierce competition in the development of G12D specific KRAS inhibitors
Several competitors are at least two years ahead
Learning from G12C: swift move to early lines and combinations to increase efficacy
Differentiation / BIC profile is needed to succeed
